description: This file defines an Angular component named 'Row' used for rendering a flexible layout row with configurable alignment and distribution styles, including associated styles and template. It appears to be part of a UI rendering library within a larger project.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: An Angular component extending DynamicComponent to render a flexible row layout with configurable alignment and distribution styles.

methods.name: alignment
methods.description: An input property for setting the alignment of the row, defaults to 'stretch'.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: An input property for setting the distribution of children within the row, defaults to 'start'.

methods.name: classes
methods.description: A computed property that constructs the CSS classes based on theme, alignment, and distribution.
